Repository-effective project LLM criteria must be injected exactly once into round_a and never into round_b, with each project finding retaining its logical criterion id in the project.* namespace

Pass-3 effective routing map governs deterministic threshold, blocking, advisory, and nit-suppression decisions for logical project ids, and project code-review ids must resolve through criteria eval with unknown or cross-gate-ambiguous ids rejected before calibration
Configuration errors for activated project criteria with missing or invalid prompt/eval specifications must raise located errors rather than silently falling back
The documentation story requires four distinct subheadings under Code-review project criteria section: Round A/B fan-in, Effective routing in Pass 3, criteria eval resolution, and Configuration error
